hindi: जिससे वाक्य पूरा किया जाता है, वह वाक्यशेष है।
english: That by which a sentence is completed is the remainder of the sentence (vākya-śeṣa).

words.gloss: of one whose wings are cut

hindi: “कटे पंखों वाले के समान, और राजा की चेष्टा का नाश।”
english: “Like one whose wings are cut, and the king's loss of movement.”
notes: The quotation is incomplete; the next unit says the missing word is śakuneḥ ('of a bird'). Hindi/English supply nothing beyond the quoted words.

hindi: वहाँ “पक्षी का” यह वाक्यशेष है।
english: There “of a bird” is the remainder of the sentence.

hindi: दूसरे का वाक्य, जिसका निषेध नहीं किया गया, अनुमत है।
english: Another's statement that is not rejected is approved (anumata).
notes: para may also be 'the opponent's'; rendered literally as 'another's'.

hindi: “दो पक्ष, उरस्य, प्रतिग्रह — यह औशनस मत का व्यूह-विभाग है।”
english: “Two wings, the centre, the reserve: thus [is] the division of the array of the school of Usanas.”
lines_deva: "पक्षाव् उरस्यं प्रतिग्रह इत्य् औशनसो व्यूह.विभागः" इति
lines_iast: "pakṣāv urasyaṃ pratigraha ity auśanaso vyūha.vibhāgaḥ" iti

hindi: अतिशय का वर्णन व्याख्यान है।
english: Description of excess (atiśaya) is explanation (vyākhyāna).
notes: atiśaya is rendered literally as 'excess'; the sense may be 'detailed/further description' or 'description of the special point'.

words.gloss: of those following the dharma of a saṅgha

hindi: “और विशेष रूप से संघों का, संघ-धर्म वालों का और राजकुलों का जुए के कारण भेद और उसके कारण विनाश — इस प्रकार शासन की दुर्बलता के कारण असत् का प्रग्रह व्यसनों में सबसे बुरा है।”
english: “And especially of saṅghas, of those following the dharma of a saṅgha, and of royal houses, [there is] dissension caused by gambling, [and] destruction caused by that; thus favouring of the bad is the worst of the vices (vyasana), owing to weakness of the administration.”
notes: vyasana here = vice (the king's own), not calamity of a constituent element. saṅgha-dharmin is rendered literally; it may mean 'having the constitution of a saṅgha'. asat-pragraha follows the glossary ('favouring of the bad'); 'association with the bad' is possible. The genitives are rendered literally ('of saṅghas ...').
lines_deva: "विशेषतश् च सङ्घानां सङ्घ.धर्मिणां च राज.कुलानां द्यूत.निमित्तो भेदस् तन्.निमित्तो विनाश इत्य् असत्.प्रग्रहः पापिष्ठतमो व्यसनानां तन्त्र.दौर्बल्यात्" इति
lines_iast: "viśeṣataś ca saṅghānāṃ saṅgha.dharmiṇāṃ ca rāja.kulānāṃ dyūta.nimitto bhedas tan.nimitto vināśa ity asat.pragrahaḥ pāpiṣṭhatamo vyasanānāṃ tantra.daurbalyāt" iti

hindi: गुण से शब्द की निष्पत्ति निर्वचन है।
english: Derivation of a word from quality is etymology (nirvacana).

hindi: “यह इसे श्रेय से दूर फेंकता है — इस प्रकार व्यसन।”
english: “It throws him away from the better; thus [it is] vyasana.”
notes: An etymology of vyasana (vi-√as). Rendered 'from the better' for śreyas; 'from the good/welfare' is the alternative.

hindi: दृष्टान्त, दृष्टान्त से युक्त, निदर्शन है।
english: An example, one joined with an example, is illustration (nidarśana).
notes: The relation of the three words is not certain (the second may mean 'accompanied by its application'). Rendered literally.

hindi: “क्योंकि बड़े से विग्रह में पड़ा हुआ मानो हाथी के साथ पैदल युद्ध को अपनाता है।”
english: “For one who is at war with a greater one takes on, as it were, a fight on foot with an elephant.”
notes: jyāyas = greater (stronger, older); 'greater' kept. The e-text writes 'iva.abhyupaiti' with a dot though iva + abhyupaiti is two words. hastinā is taken with pāda-yuddham ('fight on foot with an elephant').
lines_deva: "विगृहीतो हि ज्यायसा हस्तिना पाद.युद्धम् इव.अभ्युपैति" इति
lines_iast: "vigṛhīto hi jyāyasā hastinā pāda.yuddham iva.abhyupaiti" iti

hindi: आक्रान्त को अलग खींच लेना अपवर्ग है।
english: Drawing away of the overrun is apavarga.
notes: abhipluta = overrun, overwhelmed (p.p.p. abhi-√plu); vyapakarṣaṇa = drawing away. The technical sense is not certain; apavarga is left untranslated.

hindi: “पास की शत्रु-सेना को सदा बसाए, सिवाय भीतरी कोप की आशंका के।”
english: “One should always settle the near army of the enemy, except for suspicion of internal revolt.”
notes: vāsayet = causes to dwell; the object and purpose are not stated. anyatra + ablative = 'except (for)'. kopa = revolt as in glossary 8.2.

hindi: दूसरों द्वारा स्वीकार न किया गया शब्द अपनी संज्ञा है।
english: A word not agreed by others is an own designation (sva-sañjñā).
notes: asamita is obscure: 'not agreed upon / not shared / not used by others'. A misprint for asaṃmita ('not approved') is possible. Rendered literally.

hindi: “पहली प्रकृति; उसकी, भूमि में अनन्तर वाली दूसरी, एक भूमि के अन्तर वाली तीसरी।”
english: “The first constituent element; of him the one next in land [is] the second, the one with one land between [is] the third.”
notes: prakṛti here refers to the members of the ring of kings, not to the seven constituents of 6.1; glossary 'constituent element' kept. Whether prakṛti means 'constituent' or 'member of the circle' is for the reviewer. Reviewer: prathamā agrees with prakṛtiḥ ('the first constituent element'); the glossary term is kept for the members of the circle.
lines_deva: "प्रथमा प्रकृतिः, तस्य भूम्य्.अनन्तरा द्वितीया, भूम्य्.एक.अन्तरा तृतीया" इति
lines_iast: "prathamā prakṛtiḥ, tasya bhūmy.anantarā dvitīyā, bhūmy.eka.antarā tṛtīyā" iti

hindi: जिस वाक्य का निषेध किया जाना है, वह पूर्वपक्ष है।
english: A statement to be rejected is the pūrva-pakṣa (the first side).

words.gloss: of the calamities of the king and the minister
words.gram: dvandva in tat-puruṣa, n. gen. du.

hindi: “राजा और अमात्य के व्यसनों में अमात्य का व्यसन अधिक गम्भीर है।”
english: “Of the calamities of the king and the minister, the calamity of the minister is more serious.”

hindi: उसका निर्णय करने वाला वाक्य उत्तरपक्ष है।
english: The statement deciding that is the uttara-pakṣa (the later side).
notes: uttara may also be 'reply'; rendered literally as 'later'.

words.gloss: standing in the place of the peak of that

hindi: “उस पर निर्भर होने के कारण; क्योंकि राजा उसके शिखर के स्थान पर है।”
english: “Because of dependence on that; for the king stands in the place of the peak of that.”
notes: 'that' (tad) is not named in the unit; it refers back to the minister of the preceding quotation. kūṭa = peak/top; 'heap' or 'chief part' are alternatives.

hindi: जो सर्वत्र आश्रित है, वह एकान्त है।
english: [That which is] dependent everywhere is ekānta (lit. 'one-ended').
notes: The sense of āyatta ('dependent / holding good') and of ekānta ('exclusive, absolute') in this definition is uncertain; rendered literally. Hindi supplies the relative 'jo/vah' for the missing subject.

hindi: “इसलिए अपना उद्योग करे।”
english: “Therefore one should make one's own exertion.”
notes: utthāna = rising, exertion; 'exertion' chosen. The subject of kurvīta is not stated.

words.gloss: looking to what has not yet come

hindi: “बाद में ऐसा विहित है” — यह अनागत का अवलोकन है।
english: “Afterwards it is thus laid down”: [this is] looking to what has not yet come (anāgata-avekṣaṇa).

hindi: “तुला और प्रतिमान को पौतव-अध्यक्ष के विषय में कहेंगे।”
english: “We shall state balance and weights in [the section on] the pautava superintendent.”
notes: pautava is left untranslated (traditionally a department of weights and measures, but the line does not say so). The locative is rendered with a bracketed supply in English.

words.gloss: looking to what has gone by

hindi: “पहले ऐसा विहित है” — यह अतीत का अवलोकन है।
english: “Before, it is thus laid down”: [this is] looking to what has gone by (atikrānta-avekṣaṇa).

text_flags.why: possible typo: ṣk for kṣ; compare anāgata.avekṣaṇam in unit 59 and the sense 'looking'

notes: The printed spelling 'aveṣkaṇam' is read as avekṣaṇam.

hindi: “अमात्य की सम्पत् पहले कही जा चुकी है।”
english: “The excellence of the minister has been stated before.”

hindi: “ऐसे, अन्यथा नहीं” — यह नियोग है।
english: “Thus, not otherwise”: this [is] niyoga (command).
notes: niyoga = binding command / appointment; kept as a term.

hindi: “इसलिए इसे धर्म्य और अर्थ्य का उपदेश दे, अधर्म्य और अनर्थ्य का नहीं।”
english: “Therefore one should advise him [what is] in accordance with dharma and profitable, and not [what is] contrary to dharma and unprofitable.”

text_flags.why: typo: letters ay transposed; parallel to arthyam earlier in the line

notes: asya is taken as 'to him' (dative sense of the genitive); the subject of upadiśet is not stated.
lines_deva: "तस्माद् धर्म्यम् अर्थ्यं च-अस्य-उपदिशेत्, न-अधर्म्यम् अनर्थय्म् च" इति
lines_iast: "tasmād dharmyam arthyaṃ ca-asya-upadiśet, na-adharmyam anarthaym ca" iti

hindi: “इससे या इससे” — यह विकल्प है।
english: “By this or by this”: [this is] option (vikalpa).

hindi: “अथवा सबसे धर्मिष्ठ विवाहों में उत्पन्न पुत्रियाँ।”
english: “Or daughters born in the most righteous marriages.”
notes: A fragment of a longer quotation.

hindi: “इससे और इससे” — यह समुच्चय है।
english: “By this and by this”: [this is] combination (samuccaya).

hindi: “स्वयंजात पिता का और बन्धुओं का दायाद है।”
english: “The self-born is heir of the father and of the kinsmen.”
notes: svayañjāta is rendered literally; its technical sense is not given in the line and is not guessed here.

hindi: न कहे हुए का करना ऊह्य है।
english: The doing of what is unsaid is ūhya (to be inferred).
notes: ūhya may be the name of the device or the gerundive 'to be inferred'; both are kept.

hindi: “जिस प्रकार दाता और प्रतिग्रहीता की हानि न हो, उसी प्रकार कुशल लोग अनुशय की व्यवस्था करें।”
english: “In such a way that the giver and the receiver may not be harmed, so should the skilled arrange the anuśaya.”
notes: anuśaya is kept untranslated: it may mean 'regret/remorse' or the revocation of a transaction. kalpayeyuḥ rendered 'arrange'.
lines_deva: "यथा च दाता प्रतिग्रहीता च न-उपहतौ स्यातां तथा-अनुशयं कुशलाः कल्पयेयुः" इति
lines_iast: "yathā ca dātā pratigrahītā ca na-upahatau syātāṃ tathā-anuśayaṃ kuśalāḥ kalpayeyuḥ" iti

words.gloss: with the tantra-yuktis (methods of the treatise)

hindi: इस प्रकार यह शास्त्र इन तन्त्रयुक्तियों से युक्त है; इस लोक और परलोक की प्राप्ति और रक्षा के लिए कहा गया है।
english: Thus this treatise, furnished with these tantra-yuktis (methods of the treatise), has been stated for the acquisition and the protection of this world and the other.
notes: tantra here is 'treatise/system', not 'administration' as in the glossary for 8.3. 'for' renders the locatives avāptau pālane. parasya is taken as 'of the other [world]'.
lines_deva: एवं शास्त्रम् इदं युक्तम् एताभिस् तन्त्र.युक्तिभिः
अवाप्तौ पालने च-उक्तं लोकस्य-अस्य परस्य च
lines_iast: evaṃ śāstram idaṃ yuktam etābhis tantra.yuktibhiḥ
avāptau pālane ca-uktaṃ lokasya-asya parasya ca

hindi: यह शास्त्र धर्म, अर्थ और काम को प्रवृत्त करता है और रक्षा करता है; और अधर्म, अनर्थ और विद्वेष का नाश करता है।
english: This treatise sets in motion dharma, wealth and desire, and protects [them]; and it destroys unrighteousness, loss and hatred.
notes: pravartayati may be 'promotes'. anartha is rendered 'loss' (opposite of artha; compare anarthyam 'unprofitable' in unit 64). The object of pāti is not stated.
lines_deva: धर्मम् अर्थं च कामं च प्रवर्तयति पाति च
lines_iast: dharmam arthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca pravartayati pāti ca

hindi: जिसने अमर्ष से शास्त्र, शस्त्र और नन्द राजा के पास गई पृथ्वी का शीघ्र उद्धार किया, उसने यह शास्त्र बनाया।
english: By whom the śāstra, the weapon and the earth that had gone to the Nanda king were quickly rescued through indignation, by him this treatise was made.
notes: The person is not named in the unit. The first śāstra (learning) is kept as 'śāstra' to keep it apart from 'this treatise'.
lines_deva: येन शास्त्रं च शस्त्रं च नन्द.राज.गता च भूः
अमर्षेण-उद्धृतान्य् आशु तेन शास्त्रम् इदं कृतम्
lines_iast: yena śāstraṃ ca śastraṃ ca nanda.rāja.gatā ca bhūḥ
amarṣeṇa-uddhṛtāny āśu tena śāstram idaṃ kṛtam
